geometry.back_side: B-side footprints and pads are reported in KiCad board coordinates as seen from the front (no extra mirroring)
geometry.layers: restricted to layers enabled on the board
geometry.pad_bbox: axis-aligned absolute pad copper box (covers rotation and custom-shape primitives); size_mm of a CUSTOM pad is only its anchor
geometry.rotation: degrees, counter-clockwise as displayed by KiCad

scope: Native CAD pad/footprint geometry for fixture design only. Not body height, solder envelope, tolerance, measured fit, a completed fixture or a manufacturing approval.
